title: Telemetry
summary: a request id on every request, structured JSON logs through one logger, one OpenTelemetry span per request (console in dev, OTLP by env)

scripts.build:otel-preload: tsc apps/server/src/telemetry/preload.ts --rootDir apps/server/src --outDir apps/server/dist --module commonjs --moduleResolution node10 --target es2022 --strict --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck --types node

postScaffold: nothing to fill: with OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT unset and OTEL_CONSOLE unset no span leaves the process; OTEL_CONSOLE=true prints every span in dev, an OTLP/HTTP collector URL ships them

optional: `yarn build:otel-preload` after `yarn build:server`, then `node -r ./apps/server/dist/telemetry/preload.js apps/server/dist/main.js` starts OpenTelemetry before Nest loads — needed only once a library instrumentation is added (docs/telemetry.md)
